text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A after a modest gain felt good, but I should not let my purchase price or the satisfaction of locking in a gain replace judging each stock’s prospects.","I held losing positions through steep declines because selling at a loss hurt; I should reassess them promptly and not wait just to get back to my average cost.","Rarely checking my account let large losses go unexamined; I should review it regularly and make an intentional decision to hold, buy, or sell each position."]}
